name: Juice WRLD API
description: Search and stream Juice WRLD catalogue entries from the Juice WRLD API, with API-provided artwork. Recording-session entries are excluded.
author: Lumen
setup: Uses public read endpoints at https://juicewrldapi.com/juicewrld. Internet access is required. The API is community-maintained; availability and metadata can change. This extension does not bundle music files.
